# Herald Ago — Digital Product Designer & Design Engineer

> Portfolio of Herald Ago (MSc in IT). Bridging empirical user research, scalable design token systems, and front-end engineering for accessible, WCAG 2.2 compliant software.

## Primary Case Studies

- [Ungdomskort Redesign](https://heraldago.com/ungdomskort/): National Danish student transit pass website and app redesign, WCAG 2.2 AA compliant.
- [X-Bit Museum Companion App](https://heraldago.com/xbit/): End-to-end mobile app design process completed as part of the Google UX Design Certificate.
- [I Pupi Siciliani Wine E-Commerce](https://heraldago.com/ipupisiciliani/): End-to-end UX/UI, product photography, and custom WooCommerce build in Odense, Denmark (+187% YoY profit).
- [Sydbank Enterprise Data Catalog](https://heraldago.com/sydbank/): Empirical 24-person survey and UI redesign reducing task times by 66% at Denmark's 4th largest bank.
- [Tutora EdTech Platform](https://heraldago.com/tutora/): Tutoring marketplace and design system.
